additionalSupport.heading: CHARACTER HIT POINTS
additionalSupport.scope: Printed p.34 definition blocks relevant to class hit-die type, starting hit dice, hit-point accrual, maximum initially established hit points, and healing cap. The surrounding p.34 alignment discussion and unrelated character-creation text are not asserted reviewed as a complete source unit.
additionalSupport.sourceDenominator: One headed supporting section; prose clauses are not fully atomized, so the clause denominator remains unknown.

currentJoin.evidence: Current rule summary covers what hit points represent and recording current/maximum HP; bullets say hit-die type and exceptional starting dice depend on class. It is a summary, not the full printed section. Class records separately store hitDie and selected level changes.

additionalSupport.heading: CHARACTER LANGUAGES
additionalSupport.scope: Printed p.34 general/alignment language statements and directly class-relevant druid secret-tongue and thief-secret-speech references. The subsequent language-learning procedure is included only as a support pointer, not re-audited clause by clause.
additionalSupport.sourceDenominator: One headed supporting section; its multiple language categories and prose rules are not fully atomized, so the clause denominator remains unknown.

currentJoin.evidence: The rule summaries cover learning a language and alignment change; neither records the class-specific druid secret language or Thieves’ Cant as a class feature. Before-content probes using `secret tongue` in druid and `thieves cant` in thief did not match the actual a46 class records; after the two additions, both phrases match their respective prepared class documents. The proposal adds those source-backed reminders to the Druid and Thief guidance only.
